method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the s 6(5)(b) notice a court directs a party to give is a regulative rule (PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... HENCE ... MAY ... LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE) and the seat question reads plain facts; no REFUSE (a court or pair of courts the Act does not speak to answers `not covered`, asserted); every opinion the Act leaves to a court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Jurisdiction of Courts (Cross-vesting) Act 1993 (ACT), A1993-60, Republication No 4 (R4), effective 2025-03-21 (last amendment by A2025-3), ACT Legislation Register, retrieved 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1993-60.txt. No instrument brought in (none sets a number or date the Act uses).

checks.result: 115 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings; 1 #TRACE as its expect line says (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. A breached DEONTIC cannot be compared with EQUALS on this l4, so the rule is asserted through CONSIDER ... WHEN FULFILLED and the breach is #TRACEd.

scope: From the party's seat: s 3; s 4(1)-(5); s 5(1)-(8); s 6(1)-(8); s 6A(1)-(5), (8); s 7(1)-(7); s 8(1)-(3); s 9 (in the s 4 answer for the ACT Supreme Court); s 10; s 11(1)-(3); s 12; s 13; s 14(1), (2); the dictionary definitions used (ACT matter, Family Court, Full Court, judgment, party, proceeding, State, State Family Court, Territory; special federal matter asked as a fact). Out: ss 1, 2, 6A(6), 6A(7), 14(3), 15, 16, 17 and the preamble (machinery, construction, suspension and cessation by Executive declaration).
seat: the party to a civil proceeding: usually the claimant who brings it, sometimes the defendant who answers it; an intervener counts (dictionary, party)
